The foldable handle provides ease of use while traveling and the cord length is also perfect. The noise level is also not too much - helps when using for my daughter. I have attached a picture of the controls and they’re easy to adjust. Looks nice as well. I compared it with the regular hair dryer that I have and I noticed le

I really like this compact hair dryer . It is very lightweight, foldable, compact  for storage or travel. The compact size does not mean its weak. The Negative Ionic Technology generates smooth hair and lock in moisture. Also make the heat much gentler on the hair during styling for a shinier and less frizzy finish hair. It comes with 3 speeds and 2 heats. The The hair dryer adopts U-shaped heating wire to distribute heat evenly, keeps the temperature constant, so you can dry your hair quickly.
The package is pretty sample, the hairdryer is light weight, I like that it is foldable and easy for travel.

This hair dryer was beyond my expectations. It’s very silent and lightweight. It looks so nice and it’s great to take everywhere you go. I have thick long hair and it didn’t take long to get it completely dry.

reviews.t: A Great Hair Dryer for Fine Long Hair!
reviews.x: After 30+ years with the same store bought hair dryer which finally died, I decided to order this Ionci dryer. Wow, I wish I had not waited so long.  My long fine hair feels silky like when I leave the salon. It doesn't blow my hair about every which way, so it actually doesn't take as long to blow dry. It is quiet and light weight! The cord is thick and it doesn't get curly like my old dryer did.  I love the way my hair feels; Shiny and Silky!

This hair dryer went above my expectations. I have a medium/long hair and with my old hair dryer it usually takes me 15/20 min to dry my whole hair but this one it took me only 10min! The design is very modern and the hair dryer has a very light weight. I am very happy with my purchase.

Not great not bad either. If you have curly hair this is the dryer for you. Due to lack of power it us perfect for not blowing out curls. works great with the diffuser attachment. But to do a sleek blow out there really isn't enough power. takes forever to dry hair. Now sure if I will use it come winter when it's too cold to go to bed with wet/damp hair. I should return it for something stronger but meh, I'll keep it for my curly days and for travel. Folds up well for travel.

I wanted something light weight that had a diffuser to use when I wanted to “embrace” my curls. This seems to be exactly what I was hoping for. Good hairdryer for routine use but the weight is the best thing about this hairdryer.

I've been searching for a lightweight, low voltage dryer for my short, thin hair.  I like this one because the handle is in the middle, which distributes the weight better than dryers with the handle on one end.  The second setting for blower speed is just right, and between that and the diffuser I am able to dry my hair quickly and gain a little "fluff" in my hair.  It is a little noisier than is ideal, but since it dries my hair in a minute or so, I can live with it.  It is made in China, in c

Excellent for my kids, our small dog and myself. I’m not very professional but I can work with this very well. Not very powerful that’s why I love it so much I can use with my little ones safely and without noise ether.. I think it is great design and quality 💖

I have extremely thick straight hair that took me 45 mins to blow dry with my old hairdryer made by conair. I avoided it whenever possible because of the weight and time it took to dry my hair. Thinking that my hair was the problem I just accepted it.  I tried this hair dryer because it had good reviews and seemed similar to the outrageous priced dyson hair dryer that promises to cut drying time. I can’t say enough good things about this dryer! It cut my drying time to 10-15 mins!! It’s easy to

At first, I thought 1600 W was too low for my thicker hair, and in the future I might try a dryer that's 1800 W? But this hair dryer is satisfactory. I appreciate how you can fold and pack it easily (careful your finger when you're closing/opening it though, I have pinched myself a few times). Also the removable nozzle is great - I dry my hair as a whole without it, and then I put it on for blowing out/straightening.  Some criticisms/notes: - As I don't have curly hair, the diffuser doesn't work

It is lightweight and easy to use.  It does, however, leave my hair with an odd, floaty texture.  If you need more volume then this may be just what you want.  I have too much volume already, so making it feel light and almost like the dead of winter when you get bad static is not such a good thing.  It doesn't come out quite as smooth and manageable as my old hair dryer but it is pretty quick.

This dryer is very light- weight, compact, and foldable, great for travel.  I also notice that my hair is less frizzy.  However, it is loud so if you're looking for a quiet hard dryer, this is not what you should buy.  It gets very hot with the highest heat setting.  I'm not sure if one of the smaller attachment can withstand the heat.  I didn't buy it for the attachment so it is alright.

This dryer has become my new "travel dryer". Im always traveling for work and bring my own hair dryer because I can't stand the small ones provided for you on hotel rooms. This dryer is very compact and doesn't take up a ton of room in my bag. Good drying time, my whole head is dry in under 10 minutes. Plus its pretty!

I love the sleek matte finish! Super light and not very loud. I mainly use the diffuser for curly hair and I love that their is a cool air option and it’s worked amazingly! I love the fold down feature and THANK YOU for making the cord long! It definitely helps a lot.

I purchased this dryer for my mom.  They travel a lot in their motor home and she needed a new compact dryer with attachments.  Mainly a defuser.  She loves it.  It has much more power than her older one and is easy to hold also folds easily for storage.

I have tried many other hairdryers before but no one worked perfectly for my hair that is thin. Brightup has a negative ion and dries my hair without frizz. I loved the style and it's very lightweight also perfect for traveling.

reviews.t: Review updated! Read the bad reviews.
reviews.x: Read the bad reviews. I wish I’ve had read it. It won’t last longer. Buy from a reputable company like Revlon and Conair. This air dryer  is expensive and it won’t last 2 months. Chinese garbage for sure.
This is the first traveling hair dryier that I have seen with the "finger" attachments.  Absolutely love it and highly recommend it.

reviews.t: I would say it blows... barely.
reviews.x: Low volume output. I would recommend avoiding this piece of junk.

reviews.t: Not as powerful as one might think
reviews.x: While I was completely aware that I was buying a Dyson dupe, I did read several reviews before purchasing that stated this hair dryer was light, compact and very powerful. I was excited to receive it and could not wait to use it. Alas, it was all for not. Now, I have shorter (shoulder length) thick hair - so it takes a bit to blow dry. This hair dryer has less than half of the power my previous Revlon hair dryer had. It literally takes me 1.5x longer to dry my hair with this. Everything else abo

I absolutely love this blow dryer! The accessories (diffuser and umm… additional nozzle?) are magnetic and fit perfectly. It’s very lightweight. Perfect for travel, storing at home, etc.  It’s a bit bulky I guess, would be my only complaint, IF I were forced to think of one. Another con, it doesn’t fit in the standard hair accessory holder thing (?). I’ve got one of the metal things they attaches to my counter, that inker my blow dryers, straightener, curlers, etc in. This one doesn’t fit, as it

I buy this dryer in a rush But no regret better than the one I had. on July I start my new job and I need to stay couple days at the dorm, with long hair and work late, I can’t wait hours for my hair to get dry before i went to bed so I buy it just because it shipped fast, now have using It for almost two months I love it, it’s pretty, light weight and powerful than the old dryer I used at home, the old one I need 5 mins or more to get my hair done this one 2-3mins. I love it.

I really tried to like this dryer but, in the end, determined it is too hot. It is very easy to burn your scalp. I have thick wavy hair that takes about 15 minutes to fully blow dry. That’s a lot of intense heat. It took a while for me to give up on it so I can’t return it. I really like the design. I’m disappointed that it did not work for me.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the dryer as lightweight, compact, and foldable, making it convenient for travel and storage.
Many reviewers report fast drying times, even for thick or long hair.
Several reviewers note reduced frizz and smoother, silkier hair after use.
Some reviewers find the dryer lacks power, which works well for curls but makes sleek blowouts slow.
A few reviewers mention noise or heat concerns, with one calling it loud and another noting it gets very hot on the highest setting.
